dct_description_sm:
These point features are "Other" types of City of Brampton facilities that were not categorized with the rest of City owned properties.  This is a dataset of active, City owned/operated facilities including the following categories: Animal Shelter, Arena, Cemetery, Corporate Training Centre, Courthouse, Enforcement And Bylaw, Fire/Life Safety Education, General Administration, Heritage House, Maintenance, Parks Maintenance, Parks Operations Centre, Theatre, Wilderness Centre and Works Yard.

These facility types don't fit within other City facility categories that are already published, and complements layers like libraries, schools, recreation centres, etc.
